verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no GitCafe-native way for a user to define automations that run on their own in the background, such as built-in CI/actions, scheduled jobs or background agents. Webhooks and the API/CLI are developer building blocks. Buildkite and GitHub Actions only surface external CI results as checks. GitHub sync, branch mirroring and handing an issue to an external coding agent are adjacent features rather than user-configurable autonomous automations.
